content.short: cETF is the Cardano Native Governance Token for the CETF Hybrid DAO.
content.description:
CETF was created by a group of Cardano Enthusiasts, Cardano project owners and Stake Pool Operators. It will function as a Hybrid DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization).

Our goal is not just to be a fully doxed KYC/AML compliant project down the road, but a over-collateralized one as well. The Collateral will be provided not just by Cardano's Native Token ADA, but also by Cardano Native assets held in our various asset pools.
